paper_id: STEAM_ Simulating the InTeractive BEhavior of ProgrAMmers for Automatic Bug Fixing
title: STEAM: Simulating the InTeractive BEhavior of ProgrAMmers for Automatic Bug Fixing
motivation: 现有LLM修复Bug方法忽视程序员协作本质，将修复视为单阶段过程
problem_framing: 将Bug修复分解为四个阶段:报告、诊断、生成、验证，多智能体交互完成
key_insight: 模拟程序员(testdeveloperreviewer)协作行为可有效增强LLM自动修Bug能力
method_signature: 三ChatGPT智能体分饰testerdeveloperreviewer，按阶段交互生成补丁
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 未对所有替代设计进行穷尽实验，提示和超参数基于经验设置而非系统调优
evidence_for_taste: treat bug fixing as a single-stage process
neglecting the interactive and collaborative nature
generating correct patches in a single attempt can be particularly challenging
We set the number of interaction turns between the reviewer and developer to be 3, which is based on empirical suggestions
thinking_moves: 将社会工程实践(协作)映射为LLM多智能体交互框架
从单阶段端到端修复重构为多阶段流水线
引入软件工程中的角色分工思维到AI系统设计
复用行业最佳实践(bug管理流程)作为LLM行为模拟蓝图
extraction_notes: 该论文为完整文本，包含所有必要章节。作者Zhi Jin为联合作者，来自北京大学高可信软件技术教育部重点实验室。方法通过角色扮演提示工程实现，无模型参数更新。 | md truncated to head40k+tail20k
